name: Ink
note: Warm near-black. The line colour and the dark field.

name: Ink Raised
note: Panel surface on an ink field.

name: Ink Head
note: Header fill on an ink field.

name: Ink Line
note: Dashed dividers on an ink field. Never body text.

name: Bone Dim
note: Recessed paper: sunken panels, spec headers.

name: White
note: Reserved for one hero field per site.

name: Riposte Pink
note: Accent 1 of 3. Fills, bars, chips, large type.

name: Riposte Marigold
note: Accent 2 of 3. The only accent that takes INK text.

name: Riposte Teal
note: Accent 3 of 3. The dark-field working accent.

name: Pink Deep
note: Use when an accent must carry body copy on bone, or be text on bone. Bone on it = 4.53:1.

name: Teal Ink
note: Text on teal fills in diagrams. 9.60:1 on teal.
